{{wireless adapter |brand=Winstars |model=WS-WNP672N |if=Mini PCIe |chip1_brand=Ralink |chip1_model= |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=1 |rxchains=1 |sstreams=1 }}Single Band 1T1R, single chip Ralink
[http://www.win-star.com/eshop/goods.php?id=68#articles Product page] The product page displays the item as having silkscreened text of EM304 and QMI.. making it likely that at least one revision is a [[Quanta Microsystems EM304]]. The EM304 uses RT3070. This page previously had a link to a Monoprice adapter ([http://www.monoprice.com/products/product.asp?c_id=105&cp_id=10501&cs_id=1050103&p_id=6417 6417]) which may have previously shared the same images as the Winstars adapter.. but the device no longer seems to. Per [http://forum.pfsense.org/index.php?topic=47323.0 this pfsense forums link], that device uses RT3090.
